title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: How direct to be
hook: How direct are you when a player is doing it wrong?
intro: A player keeps making the same mistake.
You have tried hinting at it.
statement: Kids need honesty they can hear.
q1: Do you say it plainly and kindly —
q2: or soften it with praise around it?
q3: What does this player respond to best?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But feedback lands
t2: when it is clear and kind at the same time.
ctaLines: Straight and kind. Praise first. Ask a question.
ctaPrompt: Share your feedback habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How direct are you when a player is doing it wrong?
A player keeps making the same mistake. You have tried hinting at it.
Kids need honesty they can hear.
Plain and kind or softened with praise. There is no perfect answer.
Gentle or direct? Share your habit in the comments.
